item.title: x-article-publication Specification
item.description:
Purpose

Create an X Article draft from a converted Markdown post, resolving referenced images through the media upload endpoint. The uploader creates drafts only; it never publishes an article.

Requirements

Requirement: Authenticated requests to X Articles

The publisher SHALL authenticate to the X API with credentials supplied at run time through the repository’s secret-injection flow. Credential values MUST NOT be recorded in source, committed configuration, logs, or command history.
